h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gandhidham

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Gandhidham

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Gandhidham

c: Gandhidham grew up beside Kandla port, and the sea air that blows across Kutch carries salt far inland. Any metal left outdoors here has to resist corrosion. FunPlay Systems supplies Fun Fitness outdoor gym equipment to port and industrial townships, housing societies, schools and municipal gardens in Gandhidham. Our machines are made at our factory in Vasai, Maharashtra, about 500 km away, and reach Kutch by road.

We use galvanised pipe frames, which have a zinc coating over the steel, and roto-moulded plastic seats and pedals that do not rust. That is a sensible starting point for a coastal desert town, though salt still needs regular rinsing. Our installation team or a dealer in Gujarat installs the machines, grouted or self-standing. Send us your site size and photos, and we will return a layout drawing that marks the clear space around each station.

richText.heading: Looking after outdoor gym equipment in salty, dry air

items.q: Will salt air from the port corrode outdoor gym machines?
items.a: Galvanised frames and roto-moulded plastic parts resist corrosion well. Salt still builds up over time, so rinse the machines with fresh water regularly and follow our maintenance steps.

items.q: How often should we service the machines in Gandhidham?
items.a: Rinse every few weeks, check bolts and bearings every two or three months, and do a full inspection once a year. Call our after-sales team if any part feels loose.

items.q: Is Gandhidham far from your factory?
items.a: It is about 500 km by road from Vasai. We dispatch the machines from the factory and install them with our team or a dealer in Gujarat.
